title: DevX microtasks + morning journal
content:
Morning quick log - micro tasks and blocking notes

Goal for today: knock out a few small doc gaps that keep getting triaged + a flaky code sample in the JS quickstart. Keep items <= 30m each.

Top 3
- JS quickstart: streaming example hangs on Node 18 (observed in CI). Reproduce locally w/ node 18.15, yarn start + --stream flag. If reproduce, add note: "Node 18.15: use --stream=v2 or upgrade runtime".
- Embeddings FAQ: missing section on chunking strategy for long docs (customer question yesterday). Draft 3 short bullets + sample code for python/text-splitter.
- Example app (chatbot-sample): container env var mismatch (REDDIT_API vs REDDIT_CLIENT). Decide single name, update README, add env-check script.

Microtask checklist (quick, dev-friendly)
[ ] reproduce streaming hang and capture logs (<= 25m)
[ ] add short note to quickstart doc: compatibility table for node versions (<= 15m)
[ ] write embeddings chunking FAQ blurb + copy sample -> paste into docs (<= 30m)
[ ] small PR: rename env var in sample app + add startup guard (<= 20m)
[ ] run through tutorial on Mac M2 to confirm binary dependencies (<= 20m)

Notes-to-self / How to debug streaming hang
- Steps: clone quickstart, install deps, run with NODE_DEBUG=http node index.js --stream. capture stderr/stdout. Check for stuck on first write vs chunking.
- Suspect: old fetch polyfill + AbortController mismatch in node 18. Try node-fetch@3 vs undici polyfill.
- If polyfill fix works, note for docs: "Prefer undici on node >= 18, or include node-fetch fallback snippet."

Small copy edits for docs
- Replace ambiguous term "request payload" with "inference request body" across quickstart.
- Add note under rate limits: "burst allowances apply to hosted tier only" (customer asked).

Unresolved questions / decisions
- Should sample app default to environmental config file (.env.example) or prefer explicit CLI flags? I lean .env.example for onboarding. Decide in PR description.
- Do we document a recommended chunk size for embeddings? (start with 512 tokens, but note model-specific tradeoffs). Ask Maya for a short perf number if she has a benchmark.

Housekeeping
- Merge small PRs today before EOD so docs site deploy picks them up.
- Add unit to demo CI matrix for node 18 to catch this earlier. Ticket: DX-898.

Quick paste: tentative commit message for streaming fix PR
"docs(js-quickstart): clarify node streaming behaviour and add compatibility note; update fetch polyfill recommendation"

Timeboxing plan
- 09:00-09:25 reproduce streaming bug
- 09:30-09:50 write quickstart note + open PR
- 10:00-10:30 embeddings FAQ draft + paste into docs editor
- 10:45-11:00 sample app env var change + CI run

If blocked ping: @Maya for perf numbers, @Remy for sample app env naming preference.

Random thought: a tiny script that scans repo for "TODO" tags in // comments and opens a PR template with a checklist might save repeated triage. Add to backlog.

End of morning log.
